newsitem.title: USA: Texas power holds steady through weekend, Monday.
newsitem.headline: Texas power holds steady through weekend, Monday.

text.p: Wholesale power prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) were discussed steady through the weekend and into Monday as mild weather continued to dominate the state, industry sources said.
Temperatures through much of Texas were expected to reach highs in the mid 70s degrees Fahrenheit Friday.
Prices for peak, firm power for weekend and Monday delivery were talked steady at $25.25-26.25 per megawatt hour (MWh), the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak non-firm ERCOT power for Saturday, Sunday and Monday were pegged steady at $14.00-16.00 per MWh.
December peak power was talked steady at $25.25-25.75, while January/February ERCOT power prices were assessed unchanged at $25.30-25.85, the sources said.
